about: F1a (2026-10-23): who an AI answer names - the client, its competitors, the platforms it works with and the sources it cites. Each case is one answer, labelled entity by entity by a person reading the whole text (docs/ai-visibility-2026-10-23/fixes/F1a.md). R* are the six real DataForSEO answers of PROD_STATE.md section 5 (harness/fixtures_live, techand.ai's plan of exec 623); T* are crafted cases written for one finding each and used while the code was tuned; H* (split holdout) were written BEFORE the code and never used to tune it. Competitor ids are registrable domains (a name for a business named without a website); 'a|b' accepts either id for one business, and two predicted ids for one labelled business count as one hit and one false positive. position = the client's place among the businesses the answer offers (itself and its competitors, in order of first mention), null when it is not named.

techand.ai.note: the real AI Plan of exec 623: brand names, configured competitors (cleartax.com, azentio.com), auto rivals, the 69 learned aliases, services (Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Azure partner)

cases.source: real: ChatGPT (LLM scraper) on 'Which companies help businesses in the UAE get ready for e-invoicing?'
cases.why: six companies in a table, each with its website; EDICOM is one business (stored twice before: edicomgroup.com and edicom.com through two learned spellings); the Ministry of Finance is the cited source

six providers; ClearTax written cleartax.in is the configured cleartax.com; BEMEA 'specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365' names Microsoft as its platform (and techand.ai is a Dynamics partner itself); the ASP directory, the hub and Gulf News are cited sources

six providers by name with their websites; Advintek appears on einvoice.advintek.ae and is learned as uae.advintekglobal.com (one business); every other host is only cited (directory, ASP list, a blog list, Thomson Reuters' page)
'Thomson Reuters (formerly Pagero)' on europe.thomsonreuters.com is ONE business (stored as three before); six providers
the overview names no business at all: every host is a footnote citation (the free-zone authority meydanfz.ae was stored as a competitor before)
EDICOM is the one provider named; SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Zoho are the buyer's existing ERP to connect to (integration targets, not rivals); the other hosts are footnotes

cases.text: The most used options are Zoho Books and SAP Business One; Xero is common too. Acme ERP is a local alternative.
